title: Unshaken Love
story:
A ship was sailing across the sea.

The journey was calm at first.

The waters were quiet.

The sky was clear.

But suddenly, a storm began to rise.

Waves grew higher.

Winds became stronger.

The ship started to shake.

The passengers were afraid.

They thought the ship might not survive.

But deep below the water, the anchor held firm.

It was not visible.

But it was strong.

Because of the anchor, the ship did not drift away.

It stayed in place until the storm passed.

In life, we face storms too.

Everything around us may feel shaken.

But God’s love is like an anchor.

It holds us steady.

Even when we cannot see it.

His love does not move.

His peace remains.

And He keeps us secure through every storm.
life_lesson:
God’s love is your anchor in every storm.

Even when life feels shaken, His love holds you steady and secure.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being my unshakable anchor.

When life feels like a storm, help me to trust in Your love.

Remind me that You are holding me steady.

Fill my heart with peace in uncertain times.

Help me to rest in Your unchanging promises.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What storm are you facing right now?

Do you feel anchored in God’s love?

How can you trust Him more in this situation?
verse:
Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed.
Yet My unfailing love for you will not be shaken.
Nor My covenant of peace be removed.
